newsitem.title: USA: Trans Leasing chairman, CEO dies.
newsitem.headline: Trans Leasing chairman, CEO dies.

text.p: Trans Leasing International Inc said Richard Grossman, its chairman, chief executive officer and president, died Monday from injuries sustained last Thursday.
Grossman was 44, the company said. The company did not release other details.
In a short statement, the company said the board of directors "has conveyed their complete confidence in the current management team and in the continued success of the company."
The stock was unchanged at 3-11/16 on Nasdaq Monday.
